therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: renin-angiotensin system blockade reducing cardiovascular and renal end-organ damage
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: hypertensive patients with ischemic heart disease, congestive heart failure, or stroke history
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: composite of cardiovascular and renal morbidity/mortality events over five years

results.effect_size: HR 0.8 for stroke (valsartan 25 events vs non-ARB 46 events); composite primary events numerically lower across most components
biomarker_changes: New onset or worsening diabetes mellitus/IGT: 58 events (valsartan) vs 86 events (non-ARB)

dose_info.dose_modifications: dose titrated up to 160 mg/day; additional antihypertensives other than ARB/ACEI added if necessary

context.indication: hypertension with high cardiovascular risk (ischemic heart disease, congestive heart failure, stroke)
context.comparator: conventional antihypertensive treatment excluding ACEIs and ARBs
